decision_summary: QIF v0.6.17 Release Ready CLI Command is release-ready.
rationale: The change exposes the existing structural release gate through the canonical qif CLI, keeps fail-closed behavior covered by fixtures, and passed CLI, validation, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.17 and keep external CI adapters and semantic approval workflows for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can run release readiness through the same qif command family as validation, trace, risk extraction, and package creation.
